dedup.boundary: Current maintained corpus/research/reviews/history and previously referenced vanadium raw directories; no unrelated machine-wide absence claim. Binary PDFs additionally extracted in current research dir.
dedup.interpretation: No current material owner for either selected species in searched records. Roscoelite appears as a prior research lead and in vanadinite context. Neither modern metadata nor a host-phase mention establishes pure roscoelite bioleaching.

assessments.identity: IMA September 2026 page187: A, 1998 s.p., KV3+2(Si3Al)O10(OH)2. Special procedure is not discovery year. Blake1876 original pp31-32 identifies mica, locality and correction of prior Cr interpretation. No element-ID inheritance.
assessments.claims: Ito1965 complete 18-page original acquired from J-STAGE. Table3 p304 gives seven separate roscoelite runs. Table6 p307 is synthetic run1 powder data indexed as1M versus published natural patterns. Table8 p312 is bulk chemistry of synthetic run4, not run1. Gold capsules with no added water; exact atmosphere uncontrolled, residual organics/ammonium chloride reducing.
assessments.counterevidence: Microscope detected tiny opaque vanadium oxide inclusions despite other-phase XRD nondetection. Bulk V3+/V4+ therefore not unequivocal site-specific occupancy. Table3 covers300-600C and18000-38000psi while p314 prose says300-700C/10000-40000psi; no extrapolated extra runs. Blake notes incomplete acid extraction; no yield curated.
assessments.limits: Brigatti2003 and Zanetta2023 DOI/abstract identities verified but original graphics/supplements not acquired. HAL returns HTML challenge; Cambridge PDF route redirects to abstract HTML; other mirrors404/403/timeouts. Rendered brigatti2003-p*.png and brigatti2003.txt derive from HTML and are explicitly NOT primary full-text inspection. Zanetta author-hosted web text is available, but detailed EELS measurements are not imported without graphics/supplement.
assessments.next: Acquire modern original PDFs/supplement to independently assess natural oxidation/site assignments; investigate phase-specific microbial claims rather than transfer bulk shale results.

assessments.identity: IMA September2026 p38 A1967-019 Ca(V4+O)(Si4O10)(H2O)4. Staples1973 original distinguishes pentagonite; Pcmn/Pnma axis setting discussed in Danisi2012 p1876. No generic zeolite or vanadium substitution.
assessments.claims: Danisi2012 complete7page original plus36page appended deposit inspected: dry nitrogen single natural crystal, temperature-step data, at least30min equilibration, inferred water-site release and framework contraction, loss of order approx400C. Tables1-2 andFigures1-4 visually checked. Table2b O9=.105(8) at75C and2d O8=.24(4) at350C contradict exact water-free sites suggested by simplified abstract/formulas; record preserves residuals.
assessments.counterevidence: Crystal broke150-175C and fewer reflections/constrained water-oxygen displacement parameters followed. High-temp CIFs cav75/175/350 retain296(2)K cell/diffraction metadata; use original Table1 experiment labels. Ishida2009 full12page original: air10C/min powdered material retained diffraction after400C cooling; amorphous at higherstage, despite abstract no-intermediate-amorphous wording. Hydrogen positions could not be refined; H3O/OH model disputed by Danisi.
assessments.later_version: Martucci/Rodeghero/Cruciani2016 DOI10.1127/ejm/2015/0027-2512: institutional46page ejm150060R1 preprint acquired, not final publisher version. Pages1-9 include reviewer objections/author response; manuscript begins10. Sections2.1-2.2 pp15-17 and3.3 pp18-24, graphics and tables inspected. Ground Wagholi, separate thermal/XRPD aliquots, air5K/min. Different occupancy sequence/no split model; displacement-occupancy correlation, sample/time effects remain alternatives. Industrial-use language speculative. Referee objections to an earlier version are not silently treated as a final published correction.
assessments.next: Acquire final2016 publisher artifact and check differences from repository preprint; harmonize protocol data only with raw time/temperature/humidity evidence, never impose one universal collapse point.
